body:
Companion to the IDUNA Apple filed the same session. scripts/ux_screenshot_test.sh (make ux-screenshot-test) boots the real shank_lobby binary under headless Xvfb, sends a real synthetic Enter keypress via XTEST (python3-xlib, no xdotool dependency) to open LOBBY_LEVEL_SELECT (the default-selected first tile), screenshots the boot screen and the LEVELS overlay, fails if either is suspiciously close to solid black. Verified live: both pass against the current bin/shank_lobby. Investigated the founder's 'blank screen' report directly against this native client -- could not reproduce; renders correctly. README/CHANGELOG updated.

⚓ ☃
title: shank_lobby LEVELS overlay: real Xvfb+XTEST screenshot test shipped and passing
